newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus says no Telepiu deal near.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus says no Telepiu deal near.

text.p: French pay television group Canal Plus on Wednesday denied an Italian newspaper report that it was close to an accord over the stake held by German media magnate Leo Kirch in Italian pay TV firm Telepiu.
"There are indeed negotiations, but they are not concluded," a Canal Plus spokewoman said in reply to Reuters questions.
Italian financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore said Canal Plus and Kirch were close to a deal to sell Kirch's 45 percent stake in Telepiu, which would give Canal Plus 90 percent of Telepiu.
Canal Plus acquired control of 45 percent of Telepiu when it merged with Nethold, which held the stake, last month.
The remaining 10 percent is held by Italian media magnate Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest.
